]> 23/08/2026 7:04 Snowmaking and sun!.

It's currently -4 degrees with clear skies at Perisher! Today is shaping up to be a lovely sunny day, with a top of 9 degrees and very light south to south-westerly winds.

The snowguns fired up last night, helping to top up the base with man-made snow. 194 guns ran across the resort from 8:00pm last night and are still going this morning!

35 lifts are spinning and there are 45 runs groomed and ready for sunny Sunday laps, with soft, fun conditions underfoot.

There's plenty more live music around the resort today too, with Josh Cashman at Jax Bar and Vinyl 45 at Blue Cow, so be sure to catch a performance between runs. The Australian National Freestyle Moguls Championships also kicks off today with training, ahead of competition from tomorrow through to Wednesday. Good luck to all competing!

And don't miss the great savings on offer at Slopestyle and Perisher Sports this weekend, with up to 50% off selected products while stocks last.

Have a great day out there!
